audit_log.value: I run a small mobile auto detailing business and need a clean agreement for a repeat customer with two SUVs. We started with one wash per month, but now they often request interior deep cleans, pet hair removal, stain treatment, headlight restoration, and last-minute add-on visits before trips or events. Payment timing has become inconsistent and they sometimes ask for extra work without confirming price first. I need something simple and professional that clearly defines the monthly plan, what services are included, pricing for extras, approval required before additional work begins, scheduling windows, cancellation notice, access to the vehicles, responsibility for personal items left inside, weather rescheduling, before/after photo permission, and a smooth way for both sides to review and sign online.
